final:
# Tidepool Landing Page — Revised Build Plan

**What changed:** the rail now uses all five days (v1 orphaned MON and FRI); the headline is rewritten in Tidepool's own voice instead of tracing the library page's sentence; coral gets a semantic rule; the generic logo strip becomes real evidence.

**Palette & type:** warm sand ground (#F6F1E7) with subtle paper grain; deep teal (#0E3B36) for text and fills. **Coral (#FF6B57) means "now" — nothing else**: today's rail node, active states, one CTA per screen, one underline. Seafoam (#A8CFC6) for screenshot chrome so coral stays scarce. Headlines in Söhne; day labels, annotations, and the quote in mono.

**1. Week-rail (sticky, full page height)**
MON–FRI nodes on a thin vertical line that fills downward like a rising tide as you scroll. Each node anchors a section; the active node fills coral and its label swaps to the section name ("WED — See the drift"). The rail becomes the page's table of contents *and* its narrative: Monday plan → Tuesday–Thursday work → Friday close.

**2. Nav:** wordmark, three feature links, coral "Start free."

**3. Hero (MON node)**
Left: the long-breath headline — *"Your team's week in one place — every task owned, every handoff timed, every slip visible the morning it happens — so the plan you make Monday is still the plan you're living on Friday."* Coral hand-drawn underline beneath "still the plan." Right: week-grid screenshot with a live "tide meter" showing how full the week is. Marker-textured arrow curves to it, annotated in handwriting: *"your whole week, one screen."*

**4. Features (TUE–THU)**
- **Set the week:** the 11-minute Monday ritual; drag tasks onto days.
- **See the drift:** when a task slips, a coral ripple shows what it delays downstream — drift made visible.
- **Close the loop:** Friday retro auto-built from what actually happened.
Each block 60/40 text-to-cropped-UI. Copy in second-person plural, concrete numbers: "your team of six, not your org chart."

**5. Pull quote (leads into FRI)**
Mono, oversized coral mark: *"We stopped doing status meetings entirely. The week just shows us itself."* — Priya, ops lead, 7-person studio.

**6. Proof:** three miniature week cards (anonymized: *5-person dev team · 23 tasks · 2 slips caught Wednesday*) plus one stat line. No logo wall.

**7. Final CTA (FRI node):** teal band, wave-cut top edge — "Close your first week." Button: "Start free — takes one Monday." Mono footer.

Motion throughout respects `prefers-reduced-motion` (tide fill becomes instant).
